message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.fo.en: Enrichment Chamber formed: %s×%s×%s, %s Holding Blocks, %s / %s MRU
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.fo.zh: 富集仓已成形：%s×%s×%s，存储方块 %s 个，存量 %s / %s MRU

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.ov.en: Stored MRU is above the current capacity: the extra is kept, but nothing can be added until it drops below the limit.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.ov.zh: 存量超过了现在的上限：多出来的 MRU 留着，但取到上限以下之前加不进去。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.si.en: Wrong shell size: each side must be %s to %s blocks long (if the controller's face merges with casing blocks outside it, they count as part of that face).
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.si.zh: 外壳大小不对：每条边要在 %s~%s 格之间（控制器所在的面和外面的外壳方块连成一片时，外面那些也会被算进这一面）。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.ga.en: The shell has a gap at %s, %s, %s (that block can't be part of the shell).
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.ga.zh: 外壳在 %s, %s, %s 处缺了一块（那里的方块不能做外壳）。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.ex.en: There is another controller in the shell at %s, %s, %s: a chamber can only have one.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.ex.zh: 外壳上还有一个控制器（%s, %s, %s）：一座富集仓只能有一个控制器。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.no.en: No complete hollow cuboid shell found. The controller must be part of the shell; check its face for gaps, and don't let that face merge with casing blocks outside it.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.no.zh: 找不到完整的空心长方体外壳：控制器要是外壳的一格。看看控制器所在的那一面有没有缺块，这一面也不能和外面的外壳方块连成一片。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.un.en: Part of the shell is in an unloaded chunk, so it can't be checked right now.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.un.zh: 外壳有一部分在未加载的区块里，这次判断不了。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.un.en: Treating it as formed for now.
Treating it as not formed for now.

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.ke.en: The controller still holds %s MRU; fix the shell to use it again.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.ke.zh: 控制器里还存着 %s MRU，补好外壳就能接着用。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse progress: %s / %s s (Hoanna event: +%s per second)
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩进度：%s / %s 秒（海纳尔天灾中，每秒 +%s）

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the shell is incomplete.
Collapse paused: MRUCUs don't collapse in this dimension.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：这个维度里聚集体不会坍缩。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the shell has %s Void Stone, Void Glass and Demonic Plating blocks; it needs at least %s.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：外壳里虚空石、虚空玻璃、恶魔护板一共 %s 块，至少要 %s 块。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the shell needs an Enrichment Chamber Stabilizer.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：外壳上要砌一块富集仓稳定器。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: there is no MRUCU inside the chamber.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：仓里没有 MRU 聚集体。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the MRUCU inside holds %s MRU; it must be full (%s).
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：仓里的聚集体存着 %s MRU，要存满 %s。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the chamber stores %s MRU; it needs at least %s.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：仓里存着 %s MRU，至少要 %s。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the chamber's balance is %s; it must be at most %s (Void Core) or at least %s (MRU Reactor).
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：仓的平衡值是 %s，要不高于 %s（凝出虚空核心）或不低于 %s（凝出 MRU 反应核）。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapsing: the chamber is frozen, so it will condense a Void Core.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 正在坍缩：仓是冰冻的，会凝出虚空核心。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapsing: the chamber is chaotic, so it will condense an MRU Reactor.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 正在坍缩：仓是混沌的，会凝出 MRU 反应核。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the product inside the chamber is already a full stack. Open up a shell block and take it out, and it carries on.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：仓里的产物满一组了，拆开一块外壳拿出来就接着坍缩。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the chunks the shell spans aren't fully loaded yet.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：外壳所在的区块还没加载全。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse paused: the product was stopped from appearing in the chamber. The MRUCU and the stored MRU are untouched, and it tries again every second.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩停着：产物没能出现在仓里，被拦下了。聚集体和仓里的 MRU 都没动，每秒再试一次。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: The MRUCU in the Enrichment Chamber collapsed and left a %s inside. Open up one shell block to fetch it, then put the block back.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 富集仓里的聚集体坍缩了，仓里留下一个%s。拆开一块外壳进去拿，再补上。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapse progress %s / %s s is kept; it resumes once the shell is fixed.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 坍缩进度 %s / %s 秒还留着，外壳补好就接着走。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_redstone_cont.en: Redstone output: on at %s%% MRU or more
message.essentialcraft5.ec_redstone_cont.zh: 红石输出：MRU 达到 %s%% 时开启

message.essentialcraft5.ec_redstone_cont.en: Redstone output: on when MRU is full
message.essentialcraft5.ec_redstone_cont.zh: 红石输出：MRU 存满时开启

message.essentialcraft5.ec_redstone_cont.en: (not part of a formed Enrichment Chamber, so no output now)
message.essentialcraft5.ec_redstone_cont.zh: （没有连着成形的富集仓，现在不输出）

advancements.essentialcraft5.mrucuec.des.zh: 建成一座 MRUCU 富集仓

advancements.essentialcraft5.mrucuec_big.en: Construct an Enrichment Chamber with at least 10 Holding Blocks
advancements.essentialcraft5.mrucuec_big.zh: 建成一座至少有 10 个存储方块的富集仓
